purpose: Teach: 藁/便所/破片/咲かせ/襟/受かっ/刈り/恩返し

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「藁ぶき屋根の民家を観に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Daddy was saying, "Let's go see those old houses with the thatched straw roofs."
lines.style: Bright invitation, playing up the quoted plan like a small adventure. Warm, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「公衆便所の使い方マナー」を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mommy, Daddy taught me the proper manners for using a public toilet!
lines.style: Solemnly proud, reciting it like an important grown-up lesson. Careful, deliberate child pace.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ガラスの破片に気を付けて」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Daddy said to watch out for the glass shards, okay?
lines.style: Gentle caution threading through the line, slight slowing on the warning itself. Soft, protective close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「桜を咲かせる」春の散歩したよ
lines.en: Mommy, I went on a spring walk with Daddy to watch the cherry trees bloom!
lines.style: Happy sigh of a memory, softer than his usual burst. Slowing dreamily on the blossoms.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「シャツの襟を整えなさい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Daddy was saying, "Straighten up that shirt collar of yours."
lines.style: Playfully imitating Dad's stern voice on the quote, then melting back into a smile.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「テストに受かった」って報告したよ
lines.en: Mommy, I told Daddy I passed my test!
lines.style: Bursting with pride, loud happy attack on the opening. Triumphant emphasis landing on passed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「庭の芝を刈りに行く」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Daddy said he's off to mow the lawn in the garden.
lines.style: Light, matter-of-fact report with a fond little lilt. Easy pace, small smile at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「育ててくれた恩返しに」って言ったよ
lines.en: Mommy, I told Daddy, "This is to pay you back for raising me!"
lines.style: Very earnest, delivering the borrowed grown-up phrase with utmost sincerity. Slow, careful, heart fully in it.
